name: Scribe v2 Realtime
access: ElevenLabs API: Speech to Text realtime WebSocket
ElevenAgents (the default speech recognition of an agent)

voice.input_audio: streamed PCM at 8, 16, 22.05, 24, 44.1 or 48 kHz (16-bit little-endian, mono only) or mu-law at 8 kHz; 16 kHz recommended; chunks of 0.1 to 1 second [el-stt-commit]
voice.output_audio: none: the output is text (partial and committed transcripts, optional word timestamps, entities and edited transcripts)
languages: 90+ languages with automatic language recognition, and a change of language during a session [el-models] [el-blog-scribe2rt]
voice.turn_detection: commit_strategy manual (the default; commit at silence or at a turn boundary, with an automatic commit after about 36 seconds of audio) or vad (commit on silence; the docs' example uses vad_silence_threshold_secs 1.5, vad_threshold 0.4, min_speech_duration_ms 100 and min_silence_duration_ms 100) [el-stt-commit]
voice.interruption: not applicable to a transcription model; in ElevenAgents its signals feed the platform's turn-taking system [el-agents-expressive]
voice.latency: About 150 ms for partial transcripts [el-models]; Artificial Analysis streaming run: median 0.134 s to the first partial transcript and 0.141 s to the final transcript after speech ends [aa-stt-stream]
voice.session_limit: A maximum session time exists (the error session_time_limit_exceeded) but the pages read give no value; the server closes a connection after 15 seconds without client messages; a single-use client token expires after 15 minutes [el-stt-events] [el-stt-commit] [el-stt-client]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per hour of audio, not per token: US$0.39 per hour [el-pricing-api]. Artificial Analysis lists US$6.5 per 1,000 minutes, which equals the list rate [aa-stt-stream]
